editors.notes: Integrations list is lazy-loaded; read through the page's own paginated list (library_search, category accounting) in 12 locales, plus client/supplier-invoice categories in EN and the accountant pages. countries_stated is derived from the locale lists (fr, de, es, it, nl, fr-be/nl-be) where each integration appears, not from an explicit sentence. EBICS connections are counted as api (direct bank protocol); jedeclare.com ones as via_partner. Several FR accounting-firm tools (ACD, Agiris, Cegid Quadra, MyUnisoft, Sage GE, Sage 100, Sage Despachos) connect through Regate by Qonto, Qonto's own pre-accounting product. NL/BE transaction syncs name no third party on the page. Excluded as non-accounting: Airtable, cleverlohn (payroll), Belegify, Zoho Invoice, Dougs promo offer, generic 'your ERP or TMS' EBICS entry, Regate by Qonto itself. Not found on any page read: Sage 50, Inqom, Indy, Isacompta, SAP, Scopevisio, WinBooks, Adsolut, ClearFacts, SnelStart, Holded, a3, Contasol, Quipu, QuickBooks, FreeAgent, KashFlow, Zucchetti, Danea, Sage Intacct. Help center blocked, so setup details are unverified.

editors.notes: All 31 tools of the integrations page captured (full list taken from the page's own page-data.json, since a 'load more' button hides part of it). The page states the mechanism per tool: 'API directe', or a named third party (Jedeclare, TransfertBANQUE, Bridge, Powens); when several third parties are listed all are kept in evidence. Site is French only, so countries_stated is FR for all. Jedeclare and TransfertBANQUE are themselves bank-data platforms, kept as listed. Help center only describes generic CSV/OFX/QIF exports (no software-specific format) and the Jedeclare EBICS link. Shine pages for accounting firms are now co-branded Shine / Cegid (OneConnect brings client tools such as Pennylane and Dext into Cegid Quadra Plus, Loop, Expert Plus); that is a Cegid-side import, not counted as Shine account connections. No DE/BE/NL/ES/UK/IT software found.

editors.notes: The whole marketing site finom.co is behind a Cloudflare bot challenge, so the integrations pages per country could not be read; not bypassed. Rows come from the public help center (help.finom.co, Intercom; EN/DE/FR/IT/ES/NL checked) and from finom.co/llms.txt, which lists 'Accounting: DATEV (DE), Lexware, sevDesk, Xero, QuickBooks' without mechanism. Help center documents only DATEV, Lexware Office, Fatture in Cloud (Italian accounts) and Zapier; its search returns nothing for sevDesk, Xero, QuickBooks, Pennylane, Moneybird. Coverage is therefore likely incomplete. French integrations page refused automated reading at collection; read in a browser on 2026-10-02 (no challenge to solve).

editors.notes: The integrations page gives, for each tool, the channel: EBICS (Memo Bank's own EBICS TS server, counted as api) or a named third party (Bridge, Powens, Ponto, Salt Edge, Jedeclare.com, counted as via_partner). No native accounting API connector is described; everything goes through EBICS or PSD2 aggregators. https://memo.bank/integrations redirects to /produit/integrations/. English page adds Cegid Relations Bancaires, Compta.com and Cozy. Treasury and bank-communication tools listed by the editor are kept (Kyriba, Iziago, Mata IO, Netcash, Connexis, CPI Software, Pulceo, Turbo Suite Entreprise, Cegid Exabanque). Excluded as non-accounting: ADP, Silae, Lucca, Finary, Greenly, Zapier, Cozy, Agicap, Fygr, Cashlab, Rocket Chart, Zenfirst, Ma Tréso (Bpifrance), TurboPilot, Bobbee, Winancial. Help center names Pennylane and Dext only for e-mail forwarding of receipts; exports are generic Excel/CSV. French market only, no country stated on the page. No DE/BE/NL/ES/UK/IT software found except Odoo, Zoho Books, Oracle NetSuite, Accountable.

editors.name: Revolut Business

pages_unreadable.reason: HTTP 403, 'Just a quick security check' bot-detection page

editors.notes: Not collected: every revolut.com host tried (www, help, developer) answers HTTP 403 with a bot-detection page to non-browser requests; not bypassed. Only robots.txt was readable (it also disallows */help-centre and any URL with a query string). Empty connections means 'could not read', NOT 'no accounting integrations'. Needs a manual check in a browser.
